face.happy-very: Mouth wide open in a big smile, eyes squeezed into curves.
face.sad-little: Mouth turns down a little, eyebrows nearly flat.
face.sad-quite: Mouth turns down, eyebrows tilt up in the middle.
face.sad-very: Mouth turns far down, eyebrows tilt up steeply, a tear under one eye.
face.angry-little: Eyebrows dip a little toward the nose, mouth a flat line.
face.angry-quite: Eyebrows pulled down toward the nose, mouth tight and turned down.
face.angry-very: Eyebrows pulled down hard, eyes narrow, teeth pressed together.
face.scared-little: Eyes a little wide, eyebrows a little raised, mouth wobbly.
face.scared-quite: Eyes wide, eyebrows tilted up, a wide wobbly mouth.
face.scared-very: Eyes very wide, eyebrows tilted up high, mouth stretched open.
face.surprised-little: Eyebrows a little up, round eyes, a small round mouth.
face.surprised-quite: Eyebrows up high, round eyes, a round open mouth.
face.surprised-very: Eyebrows very high, big round eyes, a big round open mouth.
face.tired-quite: Eyes shut flat, bags under the eyes, mouth drooping.
face.tired-very: Eyes shut, heavy bags under the eyes, mouth open in a yawn.
face.calm-little: Eyes open, eyebrows level, a small soft smile.
face.calm-quite: Eyes softly lowered, eyebrows level, a small soft smile.
face.calm-very: Eyes gently closed, eyebrows level and relaxed, a small soft smile.
face.proud-little: Chin level, eyebrows a little raised, a closed smile.
face.proud-quite: Chin up, eyes in soft arcs, a wide closed smile.
face.proud-very: Chin high, eyebrows raised, the widest closed smile.

scenario.birthday: It is your birthday. Your friends sing to you, and there is cake.
scenario.balloon: Your balloon floats up into the sky. You cannot get it back.
scenario.tower: Someone knocks down your tower on purpose, then laughs at you.
scenario.thunder: It is dark, and a very loud crash of thunder shakes the window.
scenario.visit: You did not know Grandpa was coming. You open the door, and there he is!
scenario.long-day: You played outside all day. Now it is night, and your eyes keep closing.
scenario.garden: You lie on soft grass. A bird sings quietly. Nothing is rushing.
scenario.puzzle: You worked hard and finished the big puzzle all by yourself.
scenario.dog: A big dog you do not know runs at you, barking loudly.
scenario.snack: Your friend breaks a cookie in half and gives you a piece.

settings.heading: Settings for grown-ups
settings.saved_offline: Saved on this device. It will sync when you are back online.
settings.scene_note: Plain is calmest. Pictures never move and stay faint behind the cards.
settings.coloured_note: Harder: "Touch the red square" needs colour and shape at once. Best after Lesson 5. Takes effect when Lesson 1 is next opened.
settings.guide_note: Turn off for a plainer screen. This is remembered on this device only.
settings.safe_note: Keeps flashing and big colour changes off. Leave this on unless you know it is safe for this child.
settings.language_note: Changes the words on screen and the spoken prompts. Remembered on this device only.
